name: pdf-toolkit
description: Local PDF operations — merge, split, rotate, extract text and tables, read metadata, and encrypt or decrypt PDF files. Runs entirely offline with no network access.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: pdf.merge
tools.description: Merge several PDF files into a single output PDF, in the given order.

inputs.description: Ordered list of input PDF paths to merge

output.description: Path to write the merged PDF

tools.name: pdf.split
tools.description: Split a PDF into multiple files. With 'ranges', produce one file per range; otherwise one file per page.

outputDir.description: Directory for the output files (default: current working directory)

ranges.description: Comma-separated 1-based page ranges, e.g. '1-3,5,8-10'. If omitted, split into single pages.

tools.name: pdf.rotate
tools.description: Rotate pages of a PDF clockwise by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.

output.description: Path to write the rotated PDF

pages.description: 1-based page numbers to rotate. Omit to rotate all pages.

tools.name: pdf.extract_text
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF. Returns full text and per-page text.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers to extract. Omit for all pages.

tools.name: pdf.extract_tables
tools.description: Extract tabular data from a PDF using pdfplumber. Returns detected tables per page.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers to scan. Omit for all pages.

tools.name: pdf.metadata
tools.description: Read a PDF's document metadata (title, author, etc.) and page count.

tools.name: pdf.encrypt
tools.description: Encrypt a PDF with a password, producing a password-protected output file.

output.description: Path to write the encrypted PDF

password.description: Password to protect the output PDF

tools.name: pdf.decrypt
tools.description: Decrypt a password-protected PDF, producing an unprotected output file.

input.description: Path to the encrypted source PDF

output.description: Path to write the decrypted PDF

password.description: Password that unlocks the source PDF
